profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, EDI Administrator & Finance Team Lead at Lifeway Christian Resources
profile.summary:
Proven IT professional with experience in technology from computer operations to project management.  Demonstrated success as individual contributor and leader in developing, implementing, and supporting application software as well as packaged system implementations and database administration.  ITIL v3 certification.  Team player, successful at building effective relationships, both internally and with customers.

Specialties: EDI Administration, EDI/XML Processing: ANSI X12, Mapping, Technical Support, Financial Applications, Data Analysis, SQL, Application Development, System Implementation, Project Management and Change Management.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, EDI Administrator & Finance Team Lead
positions.description: Lead team of analysts and developers supporting Oracle Financials and Royalty applications. EDI Administrator/Developer. Utilizing TrustedLink Enterprise (Open Text). Previously Vantage Point (Data Masons) and TrustedLink for iSeries. Responsible for EDI/eCommerce, B2B, and Supply Chain integration with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle ERP applications, and Logistics systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer, EDI Administrator
positions.description: EDI Administrator/Developer.  Utilizing TrustedLink Enterprise (Open Text). Previously Vantage Point (Data Masons) and TrustedLink for iSeries.  Responsible for EDI/eCommerce, B2B, and Supply Chain integration with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle ERP applications, and Logistics systems.

positions.title: Contract Accounting and Technology services
positions.description: Provided various accounting and technical services for Beck & Beck Attorneys. http://www.becklawnashvilletn.com/

positions.title: IT Manager of Operations, Customer Engagement
positions.description: Lead 5 person team of data analysts and programmers responsible for all aspects of healthcare data acquisition, enhancement, quality, security and distribution required to drive $25MM annual revenue for a major business unit.  Oversaw the successful import of over 75 files from customers, processing millions of records through complex cleansing, predictive modeling and identification algorithms, maintaining on time delivery rate of 99.5%, which is above specification, enforced adherence to HIPAA rules and system controls related to SOX Section 404.  Reduced headcount by 1 FTE through process optimization, better prioritization and assignment of duties.  Dramatic increase in customer satisfaction as measured by net promoter score.  While cutting costs, turned around and improved a previously negatively trending score by more than 50%.

positions.title: IT Manager of Finance Application Systems
positions.description: Lead 10 person team of technical staff responsible for the maintenance of financial and other applications.  Led the Finance, Product and Procurement project teams to successfully implement Oracle ERP from requirements gathering to cut over on time and on budget.  Achieved steady improvement in support metrics for areas of responsibility, which included General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, Purchasing, AP, Product/Inventory related Oracle modules and SOX Section 404 adherence.  Worked with other departments to coordinate the planning and execution of numerous cross functional, enterprise wide projects.

positions.title: Systems Engineer Supervisor, Database Administrator
positions.description: Managed a team supporting all of LifeWay’s database needs.  In this role I represented the DBA team on a project to develop a company wide Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plan.  Also, managed many projects to upgrade Sybase database servers in order to stay at current vendor supported versions to provide the latest features to application developers.  Duties included: database vendor relationships, technical design decisions, employee performance reviews and project management.

positions.title: Advanced Systems Engineer, Database Administrator
positions.description: Utilizing Sybase ASE, Sybase ASIQ on Sun Solaris platform and Microsoft SQL Server supported databases for Business Objects, logistics systems and various internet/intranet applications.  I worked with developers to gather application requirements for databases.  I developed backup strategies and system availability monitoring scripts.  Duties included: SQL tuning, logical and physical database design.

positions.title: Advanced Systems Engineer, Financial Application Systems
positions.description: As technical team leader, I was responsible for all phases of software development life cycle.  I managed several development projects and was responsible for technical design decisions.  I worked closely with Finance and Business Services Department sections to provide technical solutions to meet business needs utilizing VISTA and Business Objects.  Duties included: business analysis, specification writing, estimating, development, documentation and testing.

positions.title: Programmer-Analyst/DBA
positions.description:
1994-1995	Database Administrator
Supported DB2 and Oracle databases.  Primary responsibility was SQL tuning, logical and physical database design.  
1993 	   	Programmer Analyst, Customer Application Systems
Supported customer and billing application, utilizing COBOL, Easytrieve Plus and CSP.  
1991-1993   	Programmer, Financial Application Systems
Supported general ledger, accounts payable and purchasing for in house developed mainframe software in COBOL, Easytrieve Plus and CSP.  
1991 	             Computer Operator
Assisted in monitoring batch jobs, large volume of print jobs and job scheduling.
